youtube.aciklama: According to the World Health Organization's 2021 World Report on Hearing, about 83 percent of people who could benefit from hearing aids do not use them. About 80 percent of people with disabling hearing loss live in low- and middle-income countries, and most low income countries have fewer than one audiologist per million people.
